headline: Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data; vCenter, Cisco, Roller, SAP KEV due 11-23; FBI probes database hack

bullets.text: New, critical: a Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw has been exploited to steal tenant data, BleepingComputer reports. No CVE in the report yet.

Still due 11-23 in CISA KEV: VMware vCenter auth bypass CVE-2026-123890 (exploited for months before the patch; 7 outlets), Cisco Expressway hard-coded credentials CVE-2026-76466, Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 and SAP NetWeaver CVE-2025-42884.

New: the FBI is investigating an apparent hack of its key national criminal justice database, per an AP source. Separately, a large European telecom leak exposed clients of Swedbank, SEB, airBaltic and dozens of other companies.
New, cloud and AI: a Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets. OpenRouter dropped 3 providers after researchers caught months of prompt theft at AI hosting firms.
Still developing: China-linked AI agents exploited a medical-imaging zero-day for root (Amazon; no CVE yet), GnuPG's critical GPGME flaw, and PHP's seven critical RCE fixes (6 outlets).

SITCON raised to 2 (SEVERE) from 3: 8 KEV additions in three working days and 24 critical reports in two; the last 7 days scored 1.11x the 90-day average. Ransomware leak-site claims led by n0n (103), vortex (28), SoulGroup (27).

actions: Patch VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890) and Cisco Expressway (CVE-2026-76466) before the 11-23 KEV deadline; hunt for compromise back to September.
Patch or isolate Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448) and SAP NetWeaver (CVE-2025-42884), also due 11-23.
Entra tenants: follow Microsoft guidance on the exploited Connect Health flaw and review tenant audit logs for unusual data access.
Rackspace Spot customers: rotate Kubernetes secrets and any credentials stored in affected clusters.
Check which upstream providers your LLM traffic routes through, and keep secrets out of prompts.
Update PHP for its critical RCE fixes; patch LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 (KEV due 12-02) and Puppet Enterprise CVE-2026-115731 (due 12-01).
